01
Natural Materials

At Orange Offices, we believe in the beauty and authenticity of natural materials. From rich woods to stone textures, these elements ground workspaces in nature, creating environments that feel warm, organic and timeless. Using sustainable materials not only enhances the aesthetic appeal of the office but also promotes a deeper connection between people and the spaces they inhabit.

02
Sustainability

Sustainability is at the core of our design philosophy. We are committed to using eco-friendly materials and energy-efficient solutions in every project. By prioritizing green design, we ensure that our spaces support both the environment and the well-being of those who work in them. This approach reflects our responsibility to create workplaces that are as mindful of the planet as they are of the people who use them.

03
Less Is More

We embrace minimalism in design because it allows the essence of a space to shine. By reducing clutter and focusing on the essentials, we create work environments that foster clarity and calm. A clean, simple design enables creativity to flow without distractions, providing employees with the mental space they need to innovate and thrive.

04
Pops of Personality

Every workspace has a unique story to tell. With carefully selected art, vibrant colors and statement pieces, we inject personality into every design. These touches make the space feel alive, dynamic and reflective of the company’s identity. It’s the little details that transform a functional space into an inspiring one.

05
Light as Design

Lighting is more than just a tool; it’s a key design element that shapes the mood and functionality of a workspace. At Orange Offices, we use both natural and artificial lighting to create a harmonious atmosphere. Whether it’s the soft glow of natural light streaming through windows or strategically placed fixtures, light enhances the aesthetic and performance of a space.

06
Harmony in Contrast

At Orange Offices, we believe in the power of contrast to bring a design to life. By blending different textures, colors and materials, we create spaces that are visually engaging and full of energy. The juxtaposition of soft and bold, dark and light, modern and traditional creates a sense of balance that elevates the overall design, making it both dynamic and cohesive.

THE PROJECT
Design Brief & Workplace Strategy

Anand Rathi, a trusted name in India’s financial services since 1994, needed a workspace that matched its growth and aspirations. With a presence in 54 cities, their old office no longer supported their expanding team or evolving needs for collaboration and creativity.

We partnered with Anand Rathi to design a modern, dynamic office that reflects their professionalism and values. The result is a functional and inspiring space that fosters innovation, enhances productivity and strengthens client relationships, empowering their continued growth in the financial industry.

01
DESIGN CHAPTER
Finding the Perfect Fit

Anand Rathi’s search for a new office was driven by the need for a space that reflected their growth and values. They needed a modern, collaborative environment that would inspire both their team and clients.

Orange Offices understood our vision from the start," says a representative from Anand Rathi. "They created a space that truly feels like ours—elegant, functional and aligned with our goals.

The new office is a perfect blend of design and practicality, fostering innovation while showcasing the firm’s commitment to excellence.

02
DESIGN CHAPTER
Bringing the Vision to Life

Anand Rathi’s new office was carefully designed to support their evolving needs. The layout blends flexibility and functionality, with a mix of collaborative spaces, private areas and modern amenities, making it an ideal environment for both team productivity and client meetings.

The final result is a space that enhances the firm’s operations while inspiring creativity. Thoughtfully incorporated natural light and contemporary design elements have created an atmosphere that promotes focus, collaboration and a sense of pride among the team, positioning the office for future growth and success.

AIHP has been a reliable partner for the last seven years. During our time at Star Tower, they not only fulfilled our specific office requirements but also guided us with valuable improvements based on their expertise. Our decision to move to the 21st floor of IFC M3M was another great experience—AIHP created an incredible office environment that aligns perfectly with our wealth management services. 01
Natural Materials

At Orange Offices, we believe in the beauty and authenticity of natural materials. From rich woods to stone textures, these elements ground workspaces in nature, creating environments that feel warm, organic and timeless. Using sustainable materials not only enhances the aesthetic appeal of the office but also promotes a deeper connection between people and the spaces they inhabit.

02
Sustainability

Sustainability is at the core of our design philosophy. We are committed to using eco-friendly materials and energy-efficient solutions in every project. By prioritizing green design, we ensure that our spaces support both the environment and the well-being of those who work in them. This approach reflects our responsibility to create workplaces that are as mindful of the planet as they are of the people who use them.

03
Less Is More

We embrace minimalism in design because it allows the essence of a space to shine. By reducing clutter and focusing on the essentials, we create work environments that foster clarity and calm. A clean, simple design enables creativity to flow without distractions, providing employees with the mental space they need to innovate and thrive.

04
Pops of Personality

Every workspace has a unique story to tell. With carefully selected art, vibrant colors and statement pieces, we inject personality into every design. These touches make the space feel alive, dynamic and reflective of the company’s identity. It’s the little details that transform a functional space into an inspiring one.

05
Light as Design

Lighting is more than just a tool; it’s a key design element that shapes the mood and functionality of a workspace. At Orange Offices, we use both natural and artificial lighting to create a harmonious atmosphere. Whether it’s the soft glow of natural light streaming through windows or strategically placed fixtures, light enhances the aesthetic and performance of a space.

06
Harmony in Contrast

At Orange Offices, we believe in the power of contrast to bring a design to life. By blending different textures, colors and materials, we create spaces that are visually engaging and full of energy. The juxtaposition of soft and bold, dark and light, modern and traditional creates a sense of balance that elevates the overall design, making it both dynamic and cohesive.
